description: Editorial and ontology review for the 2026-09-15 Using AI starter set. All entries are intentionally classified as practical: several cite strong task-specific studies, but the public protocols do not generalize those results into a blanket claim that AI improves productivity, judgment, learning, or quality.

ai-professional-writing-draft.note: Task-specific randomized evidence supports faster and higher-rated mid-level professional writing with ChatGPT. The Brali protocol keeps factual verification and final accountability human and does not generalize the effect to every writing task.

ai-idea-divergence-pass.note: Multi-experiment evidence supports higher judged creativity on several ideation tasks. The protocol is limited to option generation; feasibility, selection and implementation remain separate judgments.

ai-task-frontier-test.note: The jagged-frontier evidence supports task-level evaluation and warns against assuming capability transfers to adjacent tasks. This protocol operationalizes that boundary through representative cases and acceptance criteria.

ai-customer-reply-coach.note: Large-scale field evidence supports productivity gains for a specific human-in-the-loop customer-support assistant. The protocol preserves human diagnosis, policy checking, tone and accountability.

ai-code-scaffold-test-loop.note: A controlled coding experiment supports a speed signal on one bounded task. The source is not treated as proof of universal software quality, security or maintainability gains; tests and diff review are explicit gates.

ai-learning-attempt-feedback-retest.note: A 2026 systematic review/meta-analysis found no stable overall positive learning effect after robust publication-bias correction and highlighted heterogeneity plus augmentation/substitution differences. The protocol therefore preserves learner effort and an unaided retest.

ai-source-summary-verification.note: Practical source-navigation workflow with independent reconciliation. It makes no claim that AI summaries are reliably complete or factual.

ai-meeting-notes-to-actions.note: Practical transformation workflow with privacy and reconciliation gates. Owners, decisions and dates must come from the meeting record rather than model inference.

ai-test-case-generator.note: AI output is treated only as candidate failure modes. The protocol requires verification and conversion into executable tests or checks before the ideas become QA evidence.

ai-decision-alternatives.note: Practical option-expansion workflow informed by evidence that people can over-rely on incorrect AI advice. High-stakes decision authority is explicitly excluded.

ai-rubric-critique.note: Practical feedback workflow. The user defines the rubric, inspects evidence behind the critique and accepts or rejects changes; no universal superiority claim is made.

ai-conversation-rehearsal.note: Low-risk role-play protocol for ordinary communication practice. It explicitly rejects prediction of another person's mind and avoids therapy or treatment claims.

ai-structured-extraction-check.note: Practical information-extraction workflow with traceability, visible uncertainty and consequence-weighted verification; no generic accuracy rate is claimed.

ai-sop-from-examples.note: Practical knowledge-capture workflow. Generated procedure text must be reviewed by the operator and tested on a fresh case before adoption.

ai-professional-writing-draft.reason: A writing-and-revision workflow; Using AI is the navigation collection, while Writing and Revision & Feedback are the concrete capabilities.

ai-idea-divergence-pass.reason: The protocol expands creative options before selection.

ai-task-frontier-test.reason: The user evaluates where AI belongs inside a workflow and routes work by observed task fit and risk.

ai-customer-reply-coach.reason: The practical surface is clearer customer communication under human control.

ai-code-scaffold-test-loop.reason: AI-assisted implementation is embedded in an explicit testing and review loop.

ai-learning-attempt-feedback-retest.reason: The protocol preserves learner attempts, feedback and unaided retesting.

ai-source-summary-verification.reason: The workflow compresses information while preserving traceability and source checks.

ai-meeting-notes-to-actions.reason: The protocol converts meeting records into checked decisions and action handoffs.

ai-test-case-generator.reason: The core task is failure-mode discovery followed by executable checks.

ai-decision-alternatives.reason: The protocol broadens options and challenges premature closure while keeping decision authority human.

ai-rubric-critique.reason: The model provides criterion-bound feedback on a user-owned draft.

ai-conversation-rehearsal.reason: The user rehearses wording and response flexibility for an ordinary difficult conversation.

ai-structured-extraction-check.reason: The workflow turns unstructured text into traceable structured information and verifies errors before downstream use.

ai-sop-from-examples.reason: The protocol captures recurring work as a validated operating procedure.
